title: Eyelid surgery (blepharoplasty)
what: The surgeon removes extra skin and fat from the upper or lower eyelids. The eyes look more open, and bags are smaller.
why: When the upper eyelids droop and block your view, or under-eye bags bother you.
duration: surgery usually takes 1 to 2 hours; you usually go home the same day
tell_doctor: All your medicines, especially blood thinners. Your doctor will say what to stop and when
Allergies to medicines, latex, or iodine
Dry eyes, glaucoma, or past eye surgery
High blood pressure or thyroid conditions

prepare.title: Tests
prepare.text: Blood tests, an ECG, and sometimes a GP checkup. The clinic will give you a list.

prepare.title: Anesthesia
prepare.text: It may be local numbing with sedation, or general anesthesia. Check with the clinic.

prepare.title: Food and water
prepare.text: Usually no food from the night before and no drinks for a few hours. The clinic will tell you the exact time.

prepare.title: Eyes
prepare.text: No contact lenses or makeup on the day of surgery. Bring your glasses.

prepare.title: Getting home
prepare.text: Arrange a ride home. You cannot drive.

steps: The surgeon marks the cut lines with a pen
The cut runs along the eyelid crease or just under the lashes
Extra skin and fat are removed
Cold packs are placed on the eyelids
feel: Swelling and bruising around the eyes for the first 1 to 2 weeks
Pain is usually mild and eased with pills
after: Cold compresses for the first 1 to 2 days
Stitches usually come out after 4 to 7 days
No makeup, contacts, saunas, or exercise for 1 to 2 weeks. Your doctor will say
The final look usually shows after a few months
red_flags: Sudden eye pain or worse vision: see a doctor right away or call emergency services
Swelling and bruising grow quickly on one side
A fever over 38°C (100.4°F), or pus from the stitches

faq.a: Usually in 1 to 2 weeks. Cold and keeping your head raised help.
The scar usually hides in the eyelid crease or under the lashes and becomes almost invisible over time.

reminders.text: Eyelid surgery tomorrow. No contacts or makeup. Bring sunglasses and arrange a ride home.
